searchText: Is there going to be a public announcement regarding sepolia client releases? not sure where to track releases or if they are already available for the upcoming hf, <@552133098075193354> is it just me, or are there really no Shanghai or Acapella meta-EIPs and Magicians metathreads? There will be a blog post, yes! ETA tomorrow or Wednesday We stopped doing "Meta EIPs" (although I think we should probably bring them back...!), but you can see the spec changes here: EL: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/blob/master/network-upgrades/mainnet-upgrades/shanghai.md CL: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/capella/beacon-chain.md thanks Tim! that EL spec looks like a meta EIP. the CL spec less so (maybe I'm out of the loop and not aware that CL development doesn't use the EIP process). the reason I brought these up is two-fold: * meta EIPs allow people who are less technical and less in the weeds to see how Ethereum will change under them with an upgrade (IMHO very important), * Magicians metathreads allow easier organization and input from a wider audience (as you excellently pointed out here: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/proposal-network-upgrade-meta-threads/12552, although the idea isn't new, I'm sure we had such a thread at least for Istanbul and Berlin)
